title: Supply Chain Manager, LATAM
description:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Xometry is seeking a highly analytical and data-driven Supply Chain Manager to join our expanding team. This role will be crucial in optimizing our supply chain operations, from quoting, ordering, sourcing and shipping. This role will develop appropriate forecasts, establish a results oriented Sales and Operations process with metrics and establish reporting. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in forecasting, advanced Excel modeling skills, and a proven ability to analyze large datasets to inform strategic decisions. The candidate should also be a self-starter and be able to influence senior management, guide both strategy and day-to-day execution.

Responsibilities:

  • Demand Forecasting & Planning:
    • Develop and implement robust demand forecasting models using historical data, market trends, and statistical analysis.
    • Collaborate with sales and marketing teams to align forecasts with business objectives.
    • Monitor forecast accuracy and implement corrective actions to minimize deviations.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting:
    • Extract, analyze, and interpret large datasets from various sources to identify trends and insights.
    • Develop and maintain comprehensive supply chain reports and dashboards.
    • Utilize advanced Excel functions (e.g., pivot tables, VLOOKUP, macros) to create dynamic reports and models.
    • Present key findings to stakeholders.
    • Evaluate supplier performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
    • Negotiate contracts and manage supplier relationships to ensure competitive pricing and reliable delivery.
    • Develop and maintain supplier scorecards to track performance metrics.
  • Logistics & Distribution:
    • Optimize logistics and distribution processes to ensure timely and cost-effective delivery of goods.
    • Monitor transportation costs and identify opportunities for savings.
    • Coordinate with logistics providers to ensure efficient shipment tracking and delivery.
  • Process Improvement:
    • Identify and implement process improvements to enhance supply chain efficiency and effectiveness.
    • Utilize data analysis to identify bottlenecks and areas for optimization.
    • Document and standardize supply chain processes.
  • Inventory Management & Optimization:
    • Analyze inventory levels and implement strategies to optimize stock levels, minimize holding costs, and prevent stockouts.
    • Develop and maintain inventory control policies and procedures.
    • Utilize advanced Excel modeling to simulate inventory scenarios and assess impact of changes.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in supply chain management, with a strong focus on forecasting and data analysis.
  • Proven expertise in advanced Excel modeling and data manipulation.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working with large datasets and utilizing statistical analysis.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Experience with ERP systems and supply chain management software.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with SQL or other database query languages.
  • Knowledge of statistical modeling and forecasting techniques.
  • Experience in the manufacturing industry.
  • Experience with supply chain optimization tools.
  • Experience in the Indian manufacturing and logistics environment.

Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

A área de Ux Design abrange todos os elementos que afetam a experiência do usuário . Who are we?

Interviews (the average number of interviews is 3 - the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). We will talk in depth about you, your experience, and skills, but also about the position and what will be expected of you. Of course, you will also get to know Amaris: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities!
Case study : Depending on the position, we may ask you to take a test. This could be a role play, a technical assessment, a problem-solving scenario, etc.
As you know, every person is different and so is every role in a company. That is why we have to adapt accordingly, and the process may differ slightly at times. However, please know that we always put ourselves in the candidate's shoes to ensure they have the best possible experience.
We look forward to meeting you!

We are looking for a SAP CM (Credit/Claims Management) Consultant , at a Mid to Senior level, to join strategic digital transformation projects. You will be responsible for leading implementations, designing innovative solutions, and ensuring excellence in credit, dispute, and claims management processes. Your contribution will directly optimize financial cycles across global organizations.   • Solid experience in SAP projects related to Credit Management or Claims Management, with active involvement in implementations and/or rollouts

  • Practical and hands-on knowledge of SAP FSCM (Financial Supply Chain Management) is a strong plus

  • Proven experience interacting with business areas, translating needs into technical and functional SAP solutions

  • Fluent English is essential for communication with international stakeholders and participation in global projects

  • Excellent communication skills, interpersonal relationships, and a strong results-oriented mindset

  • Based in Brazil, with full availability for remote work

What We Offer:

  • The opportunity to work on challenging and impactful projects

  • A collaborative environment that values technical knowledge and innovation

  • Flexibility for full remote work

  • Continuous professional development and learning opportunities with cutting-edge SAP solutions

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager, MAAS role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include leading public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across sectors. We have a global, distributed team of over 1200 colleagues in more than 80 countries, with few office-based roles. Teams meet periodically in person at locations worldwide to align on strategy and execution.

We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to expand the MAAS team. Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide a top-tier solution for building and managing private bare-metal infrastructure, offering a cloud-style on-demand API for physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We seek engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership, with deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage, and data center networking.

MAAS components cover the entire software stack: from hardware detection and provisioning to the web interface, API, and CLI. Successful engineers are fluent across these layers and can anticipate the impacts of design choices in a complex distributed system.

At Canonical, you need a solid technical background, but your primary responsibility is to lead an effective team and develop your colleagues. You will help them grow, perform outstanding work, find personal and professional satisfaction, and collaborate effectively. Technical leadership and a background in software engineering are prerequisites. You will lead, challenge, and develop engineers, influence company culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work on strategy and execution. You will also collaborate with other engineering teams, such as cloud-init, LXD, and cloud services.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate leadership, deep Linux knowledge, and the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.

Location : This is a remote position available in EMEA or the Americas.

The role involves:

  1. Leading a distributed engineering team in your time zone
  2. Talent development through coaching, mentoring, and career planning
  3. Managing expectations with other teams, management, and stakeholders
  4. Promoting modern software development practices
  5. Participating in code and architecture reviews
  6. Engaging with broader teams, open source community, and partners
  7. Traveling for global events (4-6 weeks per year)

We seek candidates with:

  3. A record of exceeding expectations
  4. Leadership and mentorship skills
  5. Passion for technology and personal projects

  8. Experience with Linux (Debian/Ubuntu preferred)
  9. Interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, accountability
  10. Appreciation for diversity and multicultural work environments
  11. Self-motivation and thoughtfulness
  12. Result-oriented mindset and ability to meet commitments
  13. Willingness to travel internationally twice a year
  14. Understanding of modern Linux cloud technologies (networking, storage, containers, K8s)
  15. Programming experience in Python and Go
  16. Interest in developing and growing people

Nice-to-have skills include experience with Typescript and modern web frameworks.

  • Are you bold in your decisions, with contrarian views on how to run a business?
  • Are you passionate about continuously improving your capabilities?

Concentrix + Webhelp offers eligible employees a variety of benefits, including private medical plans, competitive salaries, retirement plans, paid learning days, and flexible workplaces. Benefits vary by country/region.

In our Information Technology and Global Security team, you will deliver cutting-edge technology infrastructure, innovative software solutions, and global security for our staff and clients. You will work with the best in the world to design, implement, and strategize IT, security, application development, and solutions in today’s hyperconnected world. You will be part of the core technology team shaping the future of customer experience (CX).

We are a remote-first company seeking the best talent globally.

Role Overview

The Network Engineer is part of our 24x7 first-level support network team, focusing on network outages and related projects. You will be responsible for daily network activities, incident and change management, ensuring end-user requests are handled within SLAs. You will report to the Director, Global Networking, working onsite with a team of engineers.

Requirements

  • Advanced proficiency in English, both verbal and written (85%+).
  • 4+ years of experience in Networking (LAN/WAN & Security).
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or Engineering preferred; Cisco Certifications (CCNA, CCNP), Fortinet Certifications (FCNSA, FCNSP), and ITIL are desirable.
  • Experience with Cisco Firewalls, Routers, Switches, FortiGate UTM.
  • Deep knowledge of Cisco, FortiGate, Brocade networking products, load balancers, firewalls, routers, switches, UTMs, Wi-Fi (Cisco/Fortinet/Aruba), including maintenance and troubleshooting.
  • Expertise in networking concepts such as IPLCs, Leased Lines, MPLS, T1/T3/E1, VoIP, VPN tunnels.
  • Proficiency in configuring WAN links, VLANs, and protocols like TCP/IP, SNMP, OSPF, BGP, RIP.
  • Strong background in network security from desktop to perimeter levels.
  • Proven experience with WAN protocols (BGP, OSPF, RIP) and security mechanisms (IPSec, AES, 3DES, SSL).

Responsibilities

  • Provide 24x7 Level 1 network operational support, capacity planning, infrastructure audits, security policy/VPN configuration.
  • Support troubleshooting to maintain network systems, monitor proactively to minimize downtime, and meet SLAs.
  • Conduct InfoSec activities and manage device compliance according to the InfoSec calendar.
  • Handle incident and change management processes, ensuring requests are addressed within SLAs.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and suggest enhancements to existing infrastructure.
  • Create and deliver network documentation.
  • Maintain effective communication with stakeholders, including vendors and support teams.
  • Design, implement, and manage complex network solutions to meet organizational needs.
  • Monitor and optimize network performance, addressing issues promptly.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate new technologies and ensure seamless network operations.

Founded in 2009, Unlimit is a global fintech company with 16 offices all over the world and more than 500 employees, that offers a large portfolio of financial services - from acquiring (payment processing) to banking as a service.   1. At least 3 years of experience in acquiring and merchants underwriting.

  5. Extremely detail-oriented, organized, and have the ability to multi-task.

  7. Take initiative, ownership, and committed to challenging the status quo.

  • Documentação e suporte: Capacidade de criar e manter documentações claras e acessíveis para facilitar o uso dos recursos por outros usuários.
  • Gerenciamento de projetos: Experiência com organização e entregas de projetos de alta complexidade em engenharia de dados.
  • Cloud Computing: Experiência com provedores de nuvem, com foco em Google Cloud Platform (GCP) e serviços como Cloud Functions, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow e Cloud Storage.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Data Science, incluindo bibliotecas e frameworks para modelagem e análise de dados.
  • Familiaridade com sistemas ERP, especialmente TOTVS, em contextos de integração de dados corporativos.
  • Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) e Automação: Conhecimento em Terraform para provisionamento e gerenciamento de infraestrutura na nuvem.

description:
Company Overview

Se para você a tecnologia existe para melhorar o caminho da vida, para o nosso time também: Seu Caminho, Nossa Jornada.

Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99Pay).

Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da DiDi Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais.

Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. Nessa jornada, também nos fortalecemos nas diferentes vivências e opiniões para crescermos juntos, errar rápido, aprender e ajustar o caminho para criar soluções que tragam ainda melhores resultados.

#LI-Hybrid

Team Overview

A principal função da nossa equipe de vendas é desenvolver e expandir nosso portfólio de contas, garantindo que eles tenham um bom desempenho na plataforma 99.Através de um excelente atendimento ao cliente e de uma abordagem consultiva, o executivo de vendas deve estabelecer e manter relacionamentos comerciais bem-sucedidos e de longo prazo.

Role Responsibilities

  • Analisando dados e desenvolvendo uma compreensão profunda da dinâmica do mercado e do comportamento dos parceiros para projetar, planejar e implementar estratégias comerciais destinadas a aumentar as vendas.
  • Construindo e promovendo relacionamentos de longo prazo baseados na confiança, com uma mentalidade ganha-ganha para garantir parcerias sustentáveis e mutuamente benéficas.

  • Graduação em Administração de Empresas, Marketing, Relações Internacionais, ou áreas relacionadas.
  • 2+ anos de experiência em gestão de contas e vendas consultivas (a senioridade será avaliada ao longo do processo seletivo).

  • Habilidades interpessoais: Habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de persuadir e manter relações de trabalho construtivas, assertivas, colaborativas e cooperativas com clientes internos e externos em organizações multinacionais.
  • Habilidades analíticas: Capacidade de diagnosticar, compreender tendências de mercado e implementar planos de ação.
  • Senso de urgência e motivação para atingir objetivos enquanto analisa possíveis cenários.
  • Experiência em atingir e superar metas de vendas.
  • Conhecimento intermediário de Excel é um diferencial.

EEO Statement

  • Geramos Valor para os Usuários - Existimos para fazer o melhor para os nossos usuários e inovamos para estarmos sempre na frente. Buscamos o equilíbrio entre experiência, eficiência e crescimento, tendo a segurança sempre em primeiro lugar.
  • Somos Guiados por Dados - Acreditamos na tomada de decisão guiada por dados. Através dos números, navegamos em nosso negócio de forma estratégica.
  • Somos Donos e Focados nos Resultados - Vamos além dos interesses pessoais para focar no que é melhor para a DiDi. Sempre cumprimos o que prometemos e buscamos a excelência na execução, estabelecendo uma barra alta e dando o nosso máximo em tudo que fazemos.
  • Sempre Construímos Juntos - Juntos somos mais fortes. Temos a mente aberta e sempre remamos com respeito, empatia e confiança uns nos outros. Ouvimos a opinião de todos antes de tomar uma decisão e, quando decidimos algo, cumprimos o combinado juntos, mesmo se discordarmos.
  • Somos Íntegros - Integridade é a nossa base e a linha que nunca ultrapassamos. Comunicamos com honestidade, transparência e ouvimos a voz de todos para sempre fazer o que é certo.
  • Desenvolvemos uns aos Outros - Nosso crescimento vem da constante aventura de estarmos fora da nossa zona de conforto. Aceitamos desafios, nos superamos e trabalhamos em busca da excelência em tudo que fazemos. Desde o primeiro dia, nos desenvolvemos e ajudamos as pessoas ao nosso redor a crescerem também, elevando a nossa barra.
  • Trabalhamos com Paixão & Diversão - Somos completamente apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Mantemos um espírito leve e otimista, contagiando o nosso ambiente com energia positiva. Somos resilientes, não temos medo de enfrentar desafios e sempre celebramos nosso sucesso.
  • Vivemos a Diversidade - Para nós, o coração da diversidade é a inclusão, a igualdade e o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade promove um ambiente mais criativo e cheio de energia, por isso, celebramos as diferenças e aqui todos podem ser quem são.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Diversidade não é uma visão de futuro ou desejo de algo que queremos um dia, é um valor inegociável de quem somos hoje.

Vivemos a inclusão, a pluralidade e o respeito e, para isso, contamos com a governança do Comitê de Diversidade que atua junto com o RH, a nossa liderança e os grupos de identidade - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres e 99Famílias.

description:
ADP is hiring a Lead Quality Assurance Automation – Lyric Team

You will start your day with a scrum call to sync up the sprint work and goals with your team. Most of your day will be spent continuously evaluating existing test coverage, identifying gaps, and implementing test strategies to maximize confidence in automation and ensure product quality. Your role also involves advocating for necessary changes to improve the end-user experience.

In this role, you will collaborate with the development team and Product Owner to gather details on features to develop and use that information to build and execute product testing for ADP's web-based Human Resources solutions, ensuring usability before deployment. This role is critical to ensuring we deploy usable products.

Hybrid work model, reporting directly to our Porto Alegre Office location.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

Demonstrates advanced understanding and experience in:

  • Quality Assurance Analyst / Test Engineer
  • Selenium
  • Test Automation
  • Java, JavaScript/TypeScript
  • BDD/Cucumber
  • Jenkins
  • Writing Test Scenarios
  • Using API testing
  • Testing web UI and API applications
  • Working with Continuous Integration processes and tools like Jenkins

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • Agile. You understand that an agile environment requires flexibility. Sometimes the scope is not fully defined, and you'll need to communicate with the Product Owner and team to gather more details and refine User Stories. You and the team will define the sprint goal together. Working in two-week sprints, you need to adhere to timelines. Due to time constraints and work fluidity, you may need to take a creative approach to testing strategies. Starting test development in parallel with feature development may be an option.
  • Create & Test. You'll define test plans and scenarios and implement automated test cases for large-scale, complex software applications, focusing on verification and validation from a system and end-user perspective.
  • Collaborate. You will communicate and collaborate with developers and stakeholders, articulating clear reasons to persuade for product improvements benefiting the end user.
  • Learning. You are eager to learn new coding skills and figure things out as you go.
  • Challenges. You will encounter challenges and will be expected to find solutions.

What are you waiting for? Apply today!

description:
Your dream job! Customer Support at fun WordPress Startup

Do you dream of working for a startup that will help millions of people?

Do you have the heart of a teacher?

As a Customer Support (also known as “Happiness Engineer”) you will be responsible for keeping the wheels of a growing startup turning!

To love this role, here’s the type of person you are:

  1. You’re a Google Spreadsheet wizard.
  2. You’re amazing at following directions.
  3. You’re passionate about research and helping people.
  4. You’re incredibly organized and detailed.
  5. You’re positive and enjoy making another person’s day.
  6. You’re an excellent communicator who makes sure nothing slips through the cracks.
  7. You’re a self-starter who loves taking initiative and seeing things through to completion.
  8. You have the curiosity and desire to learn and grow your skills.
  9. You take pride in the quality and craftsmanship of your work rather than just doing it to get it done.
  10. You have prior WordPress experience and understand how plugins work, plugin and theme troubleshooting, etc.
  11. You are a linguistic legend with a command of the English language so strong it would make Shakespeare bow down in awe.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

You are the bridge between ApproveMe.com and our users. You are responsible for sales questions, general technical support, helping our users get to know the ins and outs of ApproveMe.com’s WP E-Signature plugin, and facilitating other tasks that are billing, user, or site-related.

Full Time or Part Time, we're searching for individual freelance contractors that are available for both. Our support team is a critical component of our organization, engaging with customers and potential customers each and every day.

We're searching for individuals who are long-time WordPress users who additionally know how to get their hands dirty when it comes to basic troubleshooting WordPress sites, and of course creating and customizing WordPress plugins and themes (bonus).

Self-starters that are independent, have incredible people skills, and are fluent in English are a requirement. Bar-tending or restaurant experience = bonus points. They make great support agents!

WHAT WE OFFER

Working for a fast-growing bootstrapped company is a rare opportunity, one we consider a lifestyle choice rather than a job choice. Our positions are challenging, but also come with amazing advantages and fulfillment to those who earn them. Here’s what we offer:

  1. Competitive Local Salary.
  2. Work from your home. We’re spread out all over the world – the United States, Ireland, Bangladesh, India, Indonesia and more.
  3. We happily provide or reimburse software you’ll need as well as books or courses that promote continued learning.
  4. We give you the opportunity to solve challenging and meaningful problems that make a difference.
  5. Custom branded laptop at your five-year anniversary.
  6. Ability to work with some of the best people in the business through frequent, if not daily, interactions.
  7. And in case you were wondering: no politics, no b.s., and no jerks.

LOCATION

This is a remote position - our team is spread around the globe! Our home base is in Arizona, USA, so company operating hours are Monday - Friday, 8 am - 5 pm MST (UTC -7). While full coverage is not a requirement, you must be available during a portion of the day if we need to sync up in real-time before you work on your project/tasks.

REQUIREMENTS

  1. Personal Computer with (reliable) Internet Access.
  2. Availability to participate in (bi-weekly) audio/video meetings between the hours 8 am - 5 pm PST.
  3. Available for 40+ hours per week (this is a full-time position).

HOW TO APPLY

If all of this sounds interesting, then please submit your application!

Please clearly include the following in your cover letter:

Tell us a bit about yourself and why you should be considered. Include any details about your experience, qualifications, personality, etc. that are relevant to the job posting.
We won’t be able to individually respond to all applications, but if we feel you’re a strong match, someone will be in touch shortly. Qualified candidates may be asked to complete a test assignment.

Thanks and we look forward to hearing from you!

ABOUT APPROVEME.COM

ApproveMe.com is a startup located in Phoenix, AZ. Our product WPESign transforms a WordPress powered website into a legally binding, court recognized document signing application. We’ve been collaborating with some of the most successful designers and startup founders in the world to create a new product that will literally change how the electronic signature industry approaches signing documents forever.

Durante nossa história, seguimos o DNALWSA de crescimento, inovação e governança.   • Desenvolver métricas e KPIs para medir o desempenho de campanhas de marketing e iniciativas de produto.
  • Gerar relatórios periódicos de evolução de mercado endereçável

Requirements and skills

description:
Sobre Veritran

Somos una compañía global de tecnología abocada a simplificar las experiencias bancarias.

Nuestro equipo

En Veritran, nuestro compromiso está puesto en las soluciones que creamos y en la eficiencia con que las materializamos. Con el cliente en el centro, nos enfocamos en ofrecer más que productos o servicios: revolucionamos las experiencias de los usuarios.

Cada proyecto es una promesa, un desafío donde asumimos la responsabilidad de principio a fin de dar lo mejor de cada uno.

La agilidad para adaptarnos, el talento que ponemos en juego y la innovación constante en nuestro enfoque, nos permite hacer más que mirar hacia el futuro, nos permite construirlo.

Esa es la Actitud V, la actitud que representa los pilares que nos impulsan a seguir aportando valor día a día en la vida de millones de personas.

Lo que buscamos en ti

Como Sysadmin Cloud tu misión es garantizar la excelencia operacional en la administración y mantenimiento de plataformas productivas y pre-productivas en la nube de Veritran, asegurando la disponibilidad, rendimiento y seguridad de los sistemas que soportan las operaciones críticas de nuestros clientes, que llegan a millones de usuarios finales que son aquellos que utilizan nuestras soluciones. Como Sys Admin Cloud, tu tarea será implementar las mejores prácticas, optimizar recursos y responder con eficacia a las necesidades técnicas, contribuyendo así al éxito continuo de nuestros clientes y a la reputación de la empresa en el mercado.

Para esta posición precisamos que tengas nivel de conocimiento y experiencia en:

  1. Configuración y Implementación: Configurar y desplegar infraestructuras en AWS utilizando servicios como EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM, EKS, etc. Implementar mejores prácticas de configuración y seguridad en los entornos cloud.
  2. Mantenimiento Preventivo: Realizar actualizaciones regulares de parches y versiones en sistemas operativos Linux y servicios de AWS para garantizar la estabilidad y seguridad. Implementar y mantener copias de seguridad automatizadas de datos críticos para prevenir la pérdida de información.
  3. Mantenimiento Correctivo: Diagnosticar y resolver incidentes y problemas técnicos relacionados con sistemas operativos Linux, la plataforma de Veritran y servicios de la nube. Colaborar con otros equipos para la resolución rápida y eficiente de problemas críticos.
  4. Monitoreo y Optimización: Monitorear el rendimiento de sistemas y aplicaciones utilizando las herramientas implementadas en la nube de Veritran y otros sistemas de monitoreo. Identificar y resolver cuellos de botella, optimizando recursos para mejorar la eficiencia y reducir costos operativos.
  5. Seguridad y Cumplimiento: Implementar políticas de seguridad y controles de acceso de acuerdo a la política de Veritran. Auditar regularmente los entornos cloud para garantizar el cumplimiento de normativas y políticas internas y certificaciones externas.
  6. Documentación y Colaboración: Documentar procedimientos técnicos, configuraciones de sistemas y guías de usuario para mantener un conocimiento compartido y facilitar el soporte. Colaborar con equipos de desarrollo y otros departamentos para apoyar proyectos y necesidades técnicas.

Estas son las Competencias requeridas:

  • Sólidos conocimientos en administración de sistemas operativos Linux y servicios de AWS.
  • Experiencia práctica con herramientas de automatización y scripting (Shell scripting, Python).
  • Comprensión de redes, firewall, y conceptos de seguridad en entornos cloud.
  • Habilidades analíticas para la resolución de problemas y capacidad para trabajar bajo presión.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, tanto oral como escrita y capacidad para trabajar en equipo.
  • Capacidad para comunicarse de manera efectiva con clientes técnicos y no técnicos, proporcionando asistencia oportuna y de calidad.
  • Orientación al detalle: Precisión en la ejecución de tareas y reportes.
  • Proactividad: Disposición para aprender y mejorar en el rol.
  • Adaptabilidad: Capacidad para manejar tareas variadas y adaptarse a nuevas tecnologías.

Educación y Experiencia:

  • Título universitario en Ingeniería Informática, Sistemas, o similar (Deseable).
  • Certificaciones en AWS como AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate o AWS Certified SysOps Administrator - Associate son valoradas (Deseable).
  • Experiencia previa en administración de sistemas en entornos cloud, preferentemente AWS (Deseable).
  • Experiencia comprobable en roles de soporte técnico y mantenimiento de sistemas para clientes, preferiblemente en entornos basados en la nube.

Te proponemos

  • Oportunidades de desarrollo en una compañía que crece y se transforma con agilidad, año tras año, en un contexto global y desafiante.
  • Un excelente clima de trabajo, que cuida tu salud y bienestar para que vivas una experiencia única y diferente.
  • Una cultura de trabajo colaborativa, con comunicaciones abiertas que promueven la libertad, la responsabilidad, la solidaridad y la humildad como nuestros valores fundamentales.

title: Especialista de Planejamento de Demanda
description:
Resumo da Posição:

O Planejador de Demanda é responsável por desenvolver, manter e atualizar previsões de demanda para produtos, garantindo um planejamento preciso e colaborativo que suporte as necessidades comerciais, supply chain, compras e produção. O profissional atuará como o elo entre as áreas comerciais, marketing e operações, assegurando que a empresa tenha uma visão clara da demanda futura, minimizando rupturas e excesso de estoque, além de contribuir para a otimização da cadeia de suprimentos.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração, Logística, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em planejamento de demanda, supply chain ou áreas de planejamento e controle (MANDATORIO)
  • Conhecimento avançado de ferramentas de planejamento de demanda e sistemas ERP (ex: Plannera, SAP IBP, etc).
  • Experiência com modelos estatísticos e previsões quantitativas.
  • Habilidade em análise de dados e utilização de ferramentas como Excel (avançado), Power BI ou outras plataformas de Business Intelligence.
  • Experiência em participação em processos de S&OP.
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de colaborar com diversas áreas funcionais.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com alta atenção a detalhes e gerenciar múltiplas prioridades.
  • Habilidades analíticas, de resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico

Diferenciais (Desejável):

  • Experiência em empresas com operações complexas e multi-regionais.

Atividades

  • Desenvolver e atualizar previsões de demanda com base em análises estatísticas de dados históricos, sazonalidade, tendências de mercado e informações de clientes:
  • Obter e organizar dados históricos de vendas, variações sazonais e campanhas de marketing anteriores, garantindo que estejam completos e consistentes para análise.
  • Trabalhar com dados internos (histórico de vendas, promoções passadas) e externos (dados de mercado, tendências econômicas, clima, etc.)
  • Utilizar modelos estatísticos, como séries temporais (ARIMA, média móvel, suavização exponencial) e técnicas de regressão, para gerar previsões de demanda.
  • Avaliar e selecionar o modelo mais adequado para cada tipo de produto ou categoria, dependendo do comportamento da demanda.
  • Identificar padrões sazonais e cíclicos que possam influenciar a demanda, ajustando as previsões para diferentes períodos do ano. Adaptar as previsões conforme mudanças no mercado ou em condições econômicas.
  • Incorporar Tendências de Mercado: Analisar dados de tendências de mercado e comportamento de clientes
  • Utilizar informações qualitativas das equipes de vendas e marketing para ajustar previsões, incluindo aspectos como ciclos de vida de produtos.
  • Participar ativamente do processo de S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning), revisando e ajustando previsões com base em restrições de capacidade, metas financeiras e necessidades de mercado.
  • Monitorar o desempenho das previsões de demanda (acurácia de forecast) e implementar melhorias contínuas para aumentar a precisão.
  • Acompanhar KPIs relacionados à demanda, como forecast accuracy, nível de serviço, cobertura de estoque e giro de inventário, entre outros;
  • Comunicar os resultados e insights das previsões para stakeholders internos, ajudando na tomada de decisões estratégicas e operacionais.
  • Identificar e mitigar riscos de ruptura de estoque e sobrecarga de inventário, recomendando ações corretivas.
  • Utilizar ferramentas e softwares especializados de planejamento de demanda para realizar análises detalhadas e cenários “what-if” para otimização.
  • Desenvolver diferentes cenários de previsão para simular mudanças no mercado ou variáveis internas, como variações de preço, alterações no mix de produtos ou lançamentos de novas linhas, e avaliar o impacto dessas alterações na demanda projetada.
  • Manter a integridade e a atualização dos dados nos sistemas de planejamento, garantindo que todas as informações de demanda sejam precisas e atualizadas.
  • Propor e liderar iniciativas de melhoria contínua em processos de previsão e planejamento de demanda.

WHO WE ARE

At Trustly, we’re on a mission to deliver a better way to pay and get paid. Consumers deserve a payment option that prioritizes financial responsibility, and merchants should have the independence to accept payments without unnecessary costs. This mission drives everything we do.

We’re revolutionizing the payments industry by making Pay by Bank the new standard at checkout, providing a smarter payment option to credit and debit cards. For merchants and consumers, this means the freedom to make and receive payments with greater security and ease.

Fueled by this purpose, we’ve grown into a global network connecting 9,000 merchants to 650 million consumers through 12,000 banks across 33 countries, processing over $58 billion annually. As the leader in Pay by Bank, we aim to redefine the payments experience by delivering exceptional products and unmatched value.

With regional offices in Vitória, Brazil and Silicon Valley, USA, and our global headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, we are a diverse team that spans over 30 nationalities. Embracing a culture of innovation and collaboration, our 'work from anywhere' policy allows employees in Brazil, the U.S., and Canada to work remotely within their country of residence, enabling flexibility while staying connected to our global team.

At Trustly, we believe that inclusion and diversity are essential foundations for building a fair and equitable society. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, ancestry, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, or disability status. Our main goal is to provide a fair, welcoming, diverse environment with opportunities for all collaborators. The stages of our selection process take place online and without distinction of any kind.

Now is the perfect time to join us and help accomplish our mission. If you’re inspired by purpose, thrive in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment, and are ready to shape the future of payments, we’d love to hear from you!

The FIC team is responsible for creating and developing integrations between Trustly's product and financial institutions around the world. These connectors can be direct integrations, like a REST API, or it can be any other technology that allows us to obtain the necessary information to authorize a banking/financial transaction. The FIC team is also responsible for daily monitoring the success level of each connector and also the percentage of successful or unsuccessful transactions - and having this information take actions that seek to maintain a high level of product quality.

About Us

Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 240 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. Today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.

About The Job

This role combines hands-on engineering with strategic leadership, focusing on delivering key indicators responsible for user happiness and efficient business operation. You will own a cost-efficient, highly scalable, high-availability system responsible for hosting and running tens of thousands of jobs simultaneously. You are expected to be a product-focused engineer, ready to radically improve the product in an always-changing environment.

We're looking for candidates who can design and build cloud systems, not just operate or maintain them.

The Scrapy Cloud team comprises developers, data engineers, and product managers focused on building a high-performance, scalable platform. We prioritize practical engineering and collaboration, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

Requirements

The more items you check from the following list, the better the chance we are looking for each other:

  • Proficiency in Linux internals, including namespaces, containerization, process management, and memory management.
  • Ability to benchmark and integrate commodity server hardware via cloud and bare metal providers.
  • Good presentation and mentoring skills.

We are seeking candidates who can design and build cloud systems, rather than just operate or maintain them. The role is suited for those with experience beyond managing Kubernetes/OpenShift, and who have worked with load testing, hardware profiling, or program benchmarking. Candidates should have expertise beyond high-level web frameworks like Spring Boot, Django, Jersey, or Vert.x, and experience developing cloud solutions rather than only working as solution architects.

Benefits

  • Join a self-motivated, progressive, multicultural team.

  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies and tools.
  • Receive 35 days of paid holidays.

Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.

Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.

No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².

Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.

No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.

A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.

Estamos desenvolvendo os negócios da no Brasil e precisamos aumentar nossa força de trabalho para atender à demanda do mercado. Essa pessoa irá auxiliar nas tarefas de vendas em regiões não cobertas por distribuidores. Ela será responsável por preparar cotações para os clientes com base nos leads, visitar clientes, desenvolver negócios e realizar follow-up. Também deverá buscar melhorias e desenvolver os processos do departamento para torná-lo mais eficiente e oferecer um melhor atendimento aos clientes. Será responsável por preparar e analisar a região em busca das melhores oportunidades para a Sany, atendendo aos requisitos dos clientes.

Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:

  • Ensino superior completo (engenharia, administração de empresas, etc.)
  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência em vendas, preferencialmente no setor de máquinas para construção
  • Inglês avançado (obrigatório)
  • Excel intermediário a avançado
  • Conhecimento em Power BI

title: Sr. Regional Marketing Manager (LATAM)
description:
Neo4j is the leader in Graph Database & Analytics, helping organizations uncover hidden patterns and relationships across billions of data connections deeply, easily, and quickly. Customers use Neo4j to gain a deeper understanding of their business and reveal new ways of solving their most pressing problems. Over 84% of Fortune 100 companies use Neo4j, along with a vibrant community of 250,000+ developers, data scientists, and architects across the globe.

At Neo4j, we’re proud to build the technology that powers breakthrough solutions for our customers. These solutions have helped NASA get to Mars two years earlier, broke the Panama Papers for the ICIJ, and are helping Transport for London to cut congestion by 10% and save $750M a year. Some of our other notable customers include Intuit, Lockheed Martin, Novartis, UBS, and Walmart.

Neo4j experienced rapid growth this year as organizations looking to deploy generative AI (GenAI) recognized graph databases as essential for improving it’s accuracy, transparency, and explainability. Growth was further fueled by enterprise demand for Neo4j’s cloud offering and partnerships with leading cloud hyperscalers and ecosystem leaders. Learn more at neo4j.com and follow us on LinkedIn .

Our Vision:

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

JOB TITLE: Sr. Regional Marketing Manager (LATAM)

Location : Ideally based in or near São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil OR Miami, FL,. Travel will be required especially if based outside of São Paulo.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Role Overview As a key driver of revenue growth in our LATAM region, particularly in Brazil, you will play a pivotal role in achieving our ambitious revenue targets. We are seeking a strategic and results-oriented Senior Regional Marketing Manager (RMM) who can craft and execute high-impact marketing strategies and demand generation programs that align with regional pipeline and revenue objectives.

Reporting Structure The Senior RMM will be an integral member of our Americas Marketing team, reporting directly to the VP of Americas Marketing. This role requires building robust partnerships with the Neo4j LATAM sales team and collaborating effectively with various departments, including corporate marketing, digital, developer relations, communications (PR), and product marketing, to drive business success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Development : Formulate and execute the comprehensive marketing strategy for the LATAM region, incorporating digital marketing, partnerships, public relations (in collaboration with an agency and the communications team), account-based marketing (ABM), and event initiatives aimed at generating leads, opportunities, and deals.
  • Performance Accountability : Lead the execution and optimization of the marketing mix to meet key performance indicators, including Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) and Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs). Continuously evaluate and report on the effectiveness of marketing programs to enhance execution, efficiency, and overall results.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work collaboratively across all marketing functions to design and implement effective lead generation programs, encompassing digital initiatives, corporate events, and webinars.
  • Event Coordination : Define and implement LATAM-specific events and demand generation programs, including owned events, roadshows, workshops, and participation in third-party conferences. This includes audience segmentation, registration management, promotion, lead handling, and outcome tracking.
  • Channel Partnership : Cultivate and expand engagement with regional channel partners (GCP and AWS) through joint marketing initiatives.
  • Sales Development Partnership : Work closely with Sales Development teams to gather feedback, ensuring timely and effective follow-up on leads.
  • Strategic Communication : Effectively communicate marketing strategies, value propositions, positioning, and messaging to the LATAM sales team, ensuring they are equipped with the latest, most compelling content for effective sales cycles.
  • PR : Assist in facilitating customer and press participation in local activities, including press releases, case studies, event presentations, and industry awards.

Who You'll Work With

You’ll be a key member of the Americas Regional Marketing team. The team is responsible for driving the highest quality lead generation programs that take customers and prospects through their buyers’ journey using all activities in the marketing mix including digital, partner and event programs.

As a Senior Regional Marketer, you will drive opportunities and pipeline growth by developing and executing on a quarterly marketing plan based on approved budgets. You’ll recommend digital programs, specific regional activities and local events, and determine what demand generation content needs will drive business results for the region. This position requires significant cross-functional collaboration.

Who You Are

  • Languages : Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English is required for this role. While not required, proficiency in Spanish is considered a strong plus.
  • 7+ years in Regional Marketing, with a proven track record in developing and executing pipeline-generation programs, digital initiatives, and events. Experience with Account-Based Marketing (ABM) is a plus.
  • 5+ years collaborating on PR and thought leadership strategies for regional growth.
  • Strong demand generation expertise, analytical abilities, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proven experience in event planning, execution, and post-event analysis.
  • Exceptional communication and influencing skills, effective at all organizational levels.
  • Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively, partnering with internal teams and external vendors to meet goals.
  • Goal-oriented self-starter with a proactive, independent work style who thrives in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to lead projects from concept to completion.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to work at both the tactical and strategic levels, including effective budget management and ROI optimization.
  • Technical Proficiency : Advanced knowledge of Marketo, Tableau and Salesforce is essential.
Why Join Neo4j?

Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph database in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j.

  • Raised the biggest funding round in database history ($325M Series F). Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well-funded database companies in history.
  • Co-founder and CEO Emil Eifrem has built an amazing culture that prides itself on relationships, inclusiveness, innovation, and customer success.
  • Countless industry awards . Massive enterprises and individual developers/data scientists love Neo4j. A strong sense of community and ecosystem is built around the platform.
  • A recent Forrester Total Economic Impact Study cited Neo4j as delivering 417% ROI to customers.
  • Neo4j was named as a Visionary in the 2023 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud Database Management Systems among 19 other recognized global DBMS vendors. Neo4j was also ranked as a Strong Performer among 14 top vendors in The Forrester Wave: Vector Databases, Q3 2024.

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

Our intent is to cover all things that are medically necessary and improve the quality of life. We pay 100% of the premiums for both you and your dependents. Throughout the year we celebrate our employees with events and company-wide paid breaks. We offer unlimited PTO and sick time and recognize individuals for 7 years of employment with a paid sabbatical.

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. description:
Description

ADP is hiring a Lead Developer Backend - Lyric Team

  • Are you empathetic to client needs and inspired by transformation and impacting the lives of millions of people every day?
  • Are you looking tojoin a dynamic, inclusiveteam environmentwith a culture of collaboration and belonging?

In this role, you will work within a scrum team to bring the designs and ideas to life for new or improved web applications. This work will support a mix of internal and external clients. You will work with clients, product managers, architects, software engineers, and more to plan, design, develop, test, and implement impactful solutions that support companies with one to millions of employees.

You will start your day on a scrum call to prioritize and track work. Within the team you work on, you will choose user stories to work within a sprint cycle. You will spend most of your day developing and testing your code. Every three weeks, you will be involved in the release activities.

As a Lead Developer, you will work closely with your team to lead and guide projects to success. You'll have a hands-on role designing, developing, debugging, and deploying software solutions where you can leverage your expertise with code complexities. You'll also serve as a mentor to the junior developers. In the senior role, you will balance the assigning of user stories through prioritization and consideration of the technical interests of each developer on the team. As part of our team, you'll find exciting challenges, get opportunities to grow your career, and develop solid friendships as we design what's next for ADP and the industry. Pace should not scare you. We still find time for a healthy dose of fun.

Hybrid work model, reporting directly to our Porto Alegre Office location.

To thrive in this development career, you'll need to be an expert in:

  • Strong Java developer with REST API, spring and Spring-boot development experience;
  • NodeJS, Kafka, MySQL,Kubernets, Splunk, GoldenGate;
  • Should be able to write clean code passing sonar quality gate passing;
  • Experience in writing JUNITs for coverage;
  • Good understanding of Jenkins pipelines and CI/CD process;
  • Advanced English;

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

You'll start each day with a scrum, working in a team to understand responsibilities, identify issues, and communicate coding priorities while choosing user stories to complete. You will also participate in other agile ceremonies, including scheduled sprint demos, where you will present your work to up to 90 stakeholders.

  • Build teams that thrive. As an experienced leader, you want everyone to shine. You'll start each day by checking in with your engineering team to identify priorities and challenges. You'll find a way to make the team's day go smoother. You are constantly looking for ways to share your knowledge, motivate others and keep everyone engaged and productive.
  • Build Products. You will use your technical expertise to review your team's work and help your people excel in an Agile environment. You're proactive and hands-on. When you see a potential issue, you never leave things hanging and unfinished. When you and your team deliver a finished product, it's as polished as you could make it.
  • Variety of work. There is no typical day. You could be checking in with a team in India one minute, meeting with leadership to review initiatives for the coming quarter later and tomorrow handling a few ad hoc requests from your peers in other departments.

YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Have courageous team collaboration. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and challenge one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner & doer. Mission-driven and committed to leading change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

What are you waiting for? Apply today!

title: Component Leader(d/f/m)
description:
We are seeking an Elevator Architect to join our R&D team and assist us in creating a standard global elevator product architecture, which includes the functional definition of modules and module interfaces.

You will be a member of the Global Product Architecture Team, which comprises system architecture methodology experts who coordinate and drive the creation of deliverables for the Modular Product Architecture Project.

You will collaborate closely with key stakeholders from R&D, PLM, PSM, MFG, and Field/Sales, as well as experts in all product areas, to standardize key module interfaces to minimize rework when module implementation changes.

You will also participate in the Product Architecture Update Process, which establishes the methodology and standard work for updating the architecture and standard interfaces.

This activity is a high priority for our company, as it will enable R&D efficiency and cost reduction for all elevator products.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Lead Platform Development: Lead the development and maintenance of core platform components, including kernel modules, device drivers, board support packages (BSPs), and hardware abstraction layers, ensuring seamless integration with hardware and higher-level software layers.
  2. System Image Customization: Lead the creation of Linux-based system images using the Yocto Project, tailoring configurations to meet specific hardware and project requirements.
  3. Platform Tooling and Abstraction Layers: Build and maintain tools, APIs, and abstraction layers that simplify application development. Provide a reliable and efficient platform that enables application teams to focus on delivering innovative solutions.
  4. Team Leadership and Mentorship: Lead and mentor a team of developers focused on platform development. Cultivate technical growth within the team by sharing expertise in embedded software development. Promote a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability to achieve high-quality deliverables.
  5. Planning and Transparency: Track team progress and ensure alignment with project timelines and deliverables. Maintain clear visibility into development activities, identify risks early, and adjust plans as needed to meet committed deadlines. Report progress and challenges to stakeholders to ensure transparency and accountability.
  6. Collaboration and Team Work: Work closely with the Technical Leader, Product Owner, other Component Leaders and stakeholders to align platform development with broader project goals. Collaborate with hardware engineers, platform, application and test automation teams to ensure seamless integration and optimal performance across the solution.

Qualifications:

  1. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  2. Experience: 7+ years of experience in embedded systems development, with a focus on low-level programming and Linux-based platforms.
  3. Skills:
    • Strong knowledge of embedded Linux systems, kernel programming, and hardware-software integration.
    • Experience with the Yocto Project for system image building and customization.
    • Proficiency in developing device drivers, BSPs, and hardware abstraction layers.
    • Familiarity with hardware and networking communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet, TCP/IP, GSM.
    • Strong experience with troubleshooting of complex problems in diverse environments.
    • Basic knowledge for reading electronic schematics and datasheets.
    • Familiarity with end-to-end testing approaches and test automation, preferably with hardware-in-the-loop testing, to ensure reliable integration and quality of embedded systems.
    • Experience with Agile methodologies, backlog prioritization, and tools like JIRA and Confluence.
  4. Soft Skills:
    • Strong ability to interact and align with stakeholders and technical leaders across the company, ensuring effective communication and shared understanding of project goals.
    • Proven ability to contribute to a collaborative team environment, always working as a team player and actively supporting colleagues and driving collective success.
    • Highly collaborative with excellent organizational and interpersonal skills.
    • Clear and effective communicator, able to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
    • Ability to work in a fast-paced, global environment, managing multiple priorities and adjusting to shifting requirements.
  5. Language: Proficient English communication skills, both written and spoken.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Experience with hardware development.
  2. Experience working in a global environment with cross-functional teams.
  3. Background in digital transformation, connectivity solutions, or IoT in the industrial or building automation sector.

  4. Engage in public-private partnerships and industry coalitions to unlock innovative solutions. Partner with Public Policy teams to identify key policy opportunities to accelerate zero/low-carbon fuels and transportation technology adoption.

title: Articulador Social- São Paulo/SP
description:
CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Neste contexto, a AVSI mobiliza, operacionaliza e gerencia os Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL Distribuição em São Paulo, implementando iniciativas de eficiência energética, reciclagem e engajamento comunitário em comunidades de baixa renda. Os programas são estruturados em quatro diretrizes: Relacionamento com a comunidade; Desenvolvimento local; Educação para o consumo consciente de energia; e Iniciativa de trocar resíduos recicláveis por descontos na conta de energia.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O Articulador Social atuará na linha de frente do projeto Rede Liderança, Oficinas e Palestras comunitárias na área de concessão da Enel SP. A função interage diretamente com os parceiros envolvidos (Associações de moradores, representantes de bairro, ONGs, grupos produtivos comunitários, instituições religiosas, universidades, instituições públicas e privadas), organizando e realizando os eventos.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO:

  1. Preparação e condução das reuniões de liderança com metodologia de mediação de grupos e dinâmicas;
  2. Organização e realização de Oficinas para mulheres e Palestras comunitárias;
  3. Manter um canal de comunicação próximo e direto com os parceiros, possibilitando a melhoria da qualidade dos serviços prestados pela Enel, minimizando conflitos e gerando valor compartilhado;
  4. Criar e propor estratégias de abordagem com os grupos;
  5. Realizar visitas institucionais para identificação das lideranças comunitárias;
  6. Proceder com o mapeamento e análise dos perfis das lideranças comunitárias;
  7. Prospectar líderes comunitários para fins de aplicação de questionários;
  8. Analisar e mapear os resultados e objetivos alcançados;
  9. Identificar temas levantados pelos participantes dos grupos e propor as temáticas das reuniões;
  10. Enviar relatórios periódicos de desempenho das ações do projeto;
  11. Prospectar possíveis grupos produtivos de interesse da ENEL;
  12. Participar de momentos formativos e de trabalhos propostos pela Organização;
  13. Cumprir suas atribuições conforme descrição do cargo, Código de Ética e Conduta da AVSI Brasil, e Procedimentos Operacionais Internos;
  14. Realizar outras atividades correlatas, conforme necessidade do setor.

Join to apply for the SHER Manager role at STELO GROUP

Job Title: Safety, Health, Environment, and Risk (SHER) Manager

Location: Angola (site-based)

Contract Type: Project-based

About The Role

Stelo HRM is supporting one of its clients in the mining sector to recruit an experienced SHER Manager to oversee the Construction and Implementation Phase of a mining project in Angola. The SHER Manager will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing comprehensive Safety, Health, Environment, and Risk systems, ensuring full compliance with both local legislation and international best practices.

This is a senior-level, site-based role requiring strong leadership, stakeholder management, and operational oversight in a high-risk environment.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Lead and manage the SHER team during the project's construction and implementation phases.
  2. Oversee the SHER component of the operational readiness workstream.
  3. Ensure alignment with the business's zero-harm health and safety strategy and environmental stewardship objectives.
  4. Develop and maintain effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  5. Approve and review SHER reports, data, and statistics as required by the organization.
  6. Develop and maintain SHER-related policies, processes, and procedures.
  7. Design and implement risk management systems in line with company and legislative requirements.
  8. Coordinate and ensure effective delivery of internal and external audits, certifications, and inspections.
  9. Lead SHER-related meetings, ensuring timely execution of action items.
  10. Liaise with relevant government institutions during site visits and inquiries.
  11. Provide regular business intelligence on SHER matters to relevant parties.
  12. Identify and implement appropriate SHER tools, systems, and technologies.
  13. Ensure compliance with group-level SHER policies and support SHER staff development.
  14. Oversee delivery of SHER training programmes.
  15. Uphold high standards of corporate governance and compliance.

Qualifications And Experience

  1. Degree or diploma in Safety Management, Occupational Hygiene, Environmental Management, or related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
  2. Membership in a professional accreditation body is preferred.
  3. Demonstrated experience in leading SHER programmes in risk-based environments, ideally involving large-scale construction projects.
  4. Strong knowledge of Angolan SHE legislation and standards.
  5. Experience in hazard identification, risk assessment, and SHE legal compliance.
  6. Familiarity with construction and project SHE frameworks.
  7. Proven ability to manage audit programmes and deliver effective compliance systems.
  8. Completion of COMSOC 1 & 2 (or similar mine safety training) is highly advantageous.
